messages:
maya: Quick sync: AtlasHealth pushed back on Dedicated contract. Their blocker: console needs per-route error->cost correlation and quick access to sample traces for spike investigation before security sign-off.

kevin: Understood. Rough scope? A new dashboard slice + trace link + sampling policy?

sasha: Sales notes: they need to answer 'which routes are burning our error budget and what calls are driving cost' in <5 clicks. Also want a canary rollout plan for Dedicated.

neil: Engineering sketch: avoid capturing all traces. Plan: tag requests with route_id + model_id + token_count, emit a telemetry event for every request. Sampling rules: error-triggered high-rate sampling (e.g., 5%) + low-rate baseline (0.1%). Store full trace for sampled events, keep index/metadata for longer window.

maya: Product asks to formalize acceptance criteria: (A) dashboard with per-route error %, cost per 10k requests (USD est), and a traces button; (B) sample traces linkable from row; (C) default retention 7d for full traces, 30d for metadata; (D) acceptance pack with telemetry cost delta <10% on a 30d simulated workload.

kevin: Ops: what about retention/infra impact for Dedicated customers? They expect an enterprise option for longer retention.

sasha: Proposal: default small retention to limit cost (7d full traces). Offer 30d full-trace retention as paid add-on for Dedicated/Private. Document storage/egress assumptions in the SKUs.

neil: Implementation note: runtime will emit attribute payload like: route_id, model_id, token_count, error_flag. Sampling config example: 

```
telemetry:
  sampling:
    baseline: 0.001
    on_error: 0.05
  emit_attributes: [route_id, model_id, token_count, status_code]
```

nelly: (typo) neil: Also we should include a warning in UI about token counting variance across runtimes/compression.

maya: Canary gating: fail canary if projected telemetry spend > 12% of customer's current monitoring spend OR if per-route error detection is >95% of baseline accuracy.

kevin: Action items: sasha -> UX mock for small dashboard card + detail flyout (2 business days). neil -> runtime proto and sampling test harness (4 business days). maya -> acceptance template and AtlasHealth coord (1 business day).

sasha: UX will include a compact sparkline for error spikes, a cost column (USD/10k) and a link icon that opens a sample trace modal. Will annotate what sampling rate means for visible traces.

neil: I'll add metrics for sampled_vs_total and sampling_bias to telemetry so product can validate representation. Prototype will run on staging and generate a cost estimate.

product-bot: Created tickets: PROD-7910 (console: per-route error-cost card), PROD-7911 (runtime: error sampling hook), PROD-7912 (docs: acceptance pack template). Assigned: maya/sasha/neil.

maya: I'll drop a short summary for sales to share with AtlasHealth. If they sign, we'll run a 2-week POC with a 5% error-sample window.

kevin: One more ask: include a small note in docs about quantization/token-count caveat and how we estimate USD for tokens (model price assumptions).

maya: Agreed. I'll include cost model assumptions in the acceptance pack. Will update thread after sales sync. :thumbsup:
